title: Just ok
text: Just ok. This pan is fine but I don’t like the textured bottom. I much prefer a slick bottom. It’s also 1/2 inch smaller than all of my other loaf pans. It’s heavy and the color is attractive. I just know I will never prefer it over a traditional shaped one though.

product_metadata.title: Kitcom Nonstick Bread Loaf Pan, 9.3x5.3x2.5 Inch, Heavy Duty Carbon Steel Premium Baking Pan, Champagne Gold
